purpose: Gate-1 style synthetic phasing record. A computational haplotype caller or RNA-seq phase cannot stand in for spanning molecules or parental genotypes. Spanning molecules from an unmatched genotype line cannot stand in for the confirmed assay line. Not a real-case phase call.
allelic_dropout_criterion: Call unresolved if either haplotype has fewer than 30 full-span molecules, if the two guide configurations disagree on linkage, or if recovered molecule counts are too unbalanced to exclude dropout.
notes: Synthetic fixture only. Parental genotypes, when available through approved channels, are orthogonal evidence and do not replace this record.
